validation.assignment: Within each stratum, sort S1 IDs by SHA-256(seed + NUL + source1_entity_id), then by source1_entity_id; assign floor(0.2 * stratum_size + 0.5) records to validation and the remainder to training.
validation.positive_target_rule: Each labeled S2/S3 target inherits its owning S1 partition.
validation.unmatched_target_rule: Within each source and country, deterministically hash-order unmatched target IDs and assign 20 percent to validation using the same rounding rule.
validation.leakage_rule: Validation-owned positive targets are excluded from training candidates, negatives, hard-negative mining, fitting, and threshold selection.
